## Teaching in 2026–2027

**University of Málaga**, Department of Applied Economics (Public Finance)

- **Public Finance**, Bachelor's in Public Management and Administration (2010 and 2024 curricula)
- **Spanish Public Finance**, Bachelor's in Economics
- **Fiscal Systems**, Bachelor's in Business Administration and Management, and Bachelor's in Finance and Accounting
- **Bachelor's thesis supervision** in Finance and Accounting and in Public Management and Administration

## Office hours

Throughout the academic year:

- **Monday**, 16:00–18:15, in office 2402 of the Faculty of Economics and Business
- **Wednesday**, 10:30–13:30, online
- **Friday**, 15:00–16:30, in office 2402 of the Faculty of Economics and Business

Course materials are on the UMA Campus Virtual. For anything else, write to [gonzalo.llamosas@uma.es](mailto:gonzalo.llamosas@uma.es) and put the course name in the subject line.
